note_for_thesis: DoS attack and Replay overlap heavily at the packet-feature level (independently verified across RF, full 5-model stack, and a hierarchical 2-stage classifier - all capped near 72-77% macro F1 on the 3-class problem). The hybrid model was therefore optimized for binary attack-detection, which does not suffer from that overlap. Both numbers should be reported: binary headline + 3-class as secondary/detailed analysis.
